aiven.name: Aiven

entry.quote: The round was led by Earlybird Venture Capital with participation from Lifeline Ventures and Nokia chairman Risto Siilasmaa.
entry.entry_asserted: Company release for the EUR 8M Series A (7 May 2019): Earlybird leads and Hendrik Brandis 'joins the Aiven board of directors as part of the transaction'; the firm's own page gives Invested 2019; no earlier round with Earlybird exists (company was bootstrapped, Lifeline the only earlier backer).

aiven.status_detail: Independent and operating: opened an EMEA go-to-market hub in Cork in October 2025; 2026 headlines show an acquisition (Flow AI, July) and an India launch (September). No sale or listing found.

valuation.basis: Company release: 'raised $210M in its Series D at a pre-money valuation of $3B' (so about $3.2B post-money); tech.eu the same day: 'landing a $3 billion valuation'. No later priced round found (Bing and Google News: "Aiven" Series E / valuation funding round / raises OR secondary OR tender OR IPO 2026 showed only product, office and acquisition news plus vendor pages). Older than 24 months.

aiven.notes: Managed open-source data infrastructure cloud (Kafka, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch). The live list's 'Pre-Seed' label is wrong: Earlybird led the EUR 8M Series A of May 2019 and has followed on through the Series D.

isar-aerospace.name: Isar Aerospace

entry.lead: Airbus Ventures and Earlybird Venture Capital
entry.quote: has raised $17 million in a Series A round led by Airbus Ventures and Earlybird Venture Capital.
entry.entry_asserted: SpaceNews (12 Dec 2019, first sentence visible before the paywall) names the Series A and Earlybird as co-lead; TechCrunch (28 Jul 2021): 'Earlybird and Airbus Ventures led Isar's $17 million Series A in December 2019'. The firm's page gives Invested 2019 (company founded 2018); no record of an earlier round with Earlybird.

rounds.lead: HV Capital, Porsche SE, Lombard Odier
group incl. 7-Industries Holding, Bayern Kapital, Earlybird, HV Capital, Lakestar, Lombard Odier, Porsche SE, UVC Partners, Vsquared

rounds.round: Series C extension (round closed at over EUR 220M, NATO Innovation Fund)

isar-aerospace.status_detail: Independent; signed a EUR 270M Series D on 9 June 2026 and reached orbit on its second Spectrum flight in September 2026.

valuation.basis: Series D of EUR 270M (company release, 9 June 2026); Resilience Media the same day: 'Sources close to the company confirmed that the raise was made at a post-money valuation of around EUR 2 billion.' The company release states no figure; the sibling books (HV Capital, Lakestar) carry the same figure and citation ($2.31B at ECB 1.1573). TechCrunch (8 Sep 2025) also dates unicorn status to the June 2025 EUR 150M Eldridge convertible.

isar-aerospace.notes: Orbital launch vehicle maker (Spectrum), founded 2018. The live list's 'Pre-Seed' label is wrong: Earlybird co-led the $17M Series A in December 2019, joined the Series B, subscribed 'the largest amount' in the 2021 extension and is named in the 2023 Series C. Earlybird is not named in the 2026 Series D release ('and others'). HQ: the register's legal seat is Ottobrunn; the address of Isar Aerospace SE is now Parsdorf (municipality of Vaterstetten, the new factory and HQ); the company says 'Headquartered near Munich'; the firm's page and the HV Capital book say Munich, the Lakestar book Ottobrunn.

getsafe.name: Getsafe

entry.quote: An der Runde beteiligten sich neben Earlybird, der als neuer Investor einsteigt, auch CommerzVentures und weitere bereits bestehende Investoren.
entry.entry_asserted: The release text names Earlybird as 'neuer Investor' (new investor) in the EUR 15M Series A; Cash Online: 'unter Führung von Earlybird 15 Millionen Euro in einer Serie-A-Finanzierungsrunde'; TechCrunch 2019-06-05 '$17M Series A ... led by Earlybird'.

getsafe.status_detail: Independent; Getsafe GmbH (Heidelberg, HRB 725674) active in the register; it bought helden.de in April 2026 after handing back its insurer licence in 2025 (Getsafe Insurance AG is the struck entity).

valuation.basis: No priced round states a figure of $1B or more; Series B total $93M (2021).

getsafe.notes: Digital insurance app for young customers (insurtech). Earlybird entered as a new investor leading the EUR 15M Series A in June 2019 and joined the 2021 Series B extension.

mostly-ai.name: Mostly AI

entry.quote: The round was led by Earlybird, with participation from existing investors Push Ventures and 42CAP.
entry.entry_asserted: Silicon Canals names the Series A, Earlybird as lead and Push Ventures and 42CAP as the 'existing investors'; Trending Topics (27 Feb 2020): the 2018 round brought in Push Ventures and 42CAP only, and Earlybird took 'etwas mehr als 17 Prozent' in this round. Firm page: Invested 2020.

mostly-ai.status_detail: CEO Tobias Hann announced on 4 March 2026 that the company stops operating ('den Betrieb einzustellen') after more than EUR 30M raised; the Austrian register entry (Mostly AI Solutions MP GmbH, FN 466390v) now shows liquidators. On 9 June 2026 Syntho (Amsterdam) bought the MOSTLY AI brand only; mostly.ai now reads 'MOSTLY AI powered by Syntho'. A wind-down followed by a brand sale: defunct here; the judge may read it as acquired (successor Syntho) under the asset-sale rule.

valuation.basis: No priced round states a figure; largest round USD 25M Series B (2022).

mostly-ai.notes: Synthetic data generation for enterprises (Vienna, with a New York office). Earlybird led the USD 5M Series A in February 2020 and joined the Series B. Shut down March 2026; brand sold to Syntho in June 2026 (https://www.syntho.ai/syntho-acquires-mostly-ai/). Status wording is the one judgment call: wind-down plus brand sale.

deepcode.name: DeepCode

entry.entry_asserted: TechCrunch names only btov Partners as the 'existing investor'; Earlybird leads as a new investor; firm page: Invested 2019.

searched: firm: live page says 'In 2020, DeepCode was acquired by Snyk'; archive exit note 'Merger between DeepCode and Snyk'
techcrunch search 'deepcode' -> only the 2019 seed and the 2020 Snyk acquisition; the acquisition article says DeepCode 'had only raised around $5.2 million', most recently the $4M seed
bingnews: "DeepCode" Snyk -> acquisition coverage only (SD Times, TechCrunch 2020-09)
company: deepcode.ai now redirects into Snyk (Snyk Code)

deepcode.status_detail: Acquired by Snyk, announced 23/24 September 2020; terms not disclosed. The technology became Snyk Code.

valuation.basis: Acquisition price not disclosed ('Financial terms of the deal have not been disclosed'); only about $5.2M raised.

deepcode.notes: ETH Zurich spin-off: machine-learning code review for developers ('Grammarly for coders'). Earlybird led the $4M seed in August 2019; Snyk bought the company 13 months later, before any Series A, so no graduation.

nuri-bitwala-gmbh.name: Nuri (formerly Bitwala)

entry.quote: Zusammen mit coparion investiert Earlybird vier Millionen Euro in das Berliner Fintech.
entry.entry_asserted: Earlybird's counsel announces the investment (1 Oct 2018); CoinDesk and Webrazzi (25/26 Sep 2018) report the EUR 4M round 'under the leadership of Earlybird'; the July 2019 Series A coverage calls Earlybird and coparion 'existing investors'; firm page: Invested 2018. NO source names this round (not Seed, not Series A): round left null.

graduation.quote: Sony Financial Ventures and NKB Group led the raise, while existing investors Earlybird and coparion contributed half of the funding.

nuri-bitwala-gmbh.status_detail: Nuri GmbH (formerly Bitwala GmbH, Berlin, HRB 173698 B) announced its insolvency filing on 9 August 2022, could not agree a takeover with potential investors and stopped all business on 18 December 2022 (t3n, 18 Oct 2022); register: liquidation 8 Nov 2022, insolvency proceedings ended 18 Nov 2025, company deleted ex officio 23 Apr 2026. In 2023 a founder and the venture-debt creditor Claret Capital restarted the Bitwala brand in another company with the brand rights and technology: a creditor's collateral put into a new venture, not a sale of the company.

valuation.basis: No priced round states a figure; about EUR 41M raised in total.

nuri-bitwala-gmbh.notes: Crypto bank account (bitcoin and ether trading inside a German bank account). Earlybird led the unnamed EUR 4M round of September 2018 and the EUR 15M round of November 2020. The entry round has no name in any record; the next round (July 2019) is named Series A with Earlybird as an existing investor, so the graduation block is filled in case the judge treats the 2018 round as a seed-stage entry. Register page: https://www.northdata.com/Nuri%20GmbH,%20Berlin/Amtsgericht%20Charlottenburg%20(Berlin)%20HRB%20173698%20B

conny.name: Conny (formerly LexFox)

entry.quote: Für die zwei beteiligten Wagniskapitalgeber Earlybird und Target Global ist dies ihre jeweils erste Investition in ein B2C-Legal-Tech-Startup in Europa.
entry.entry_asserted: Gründerszene (2 Sep 2019) reports the seven-digit round with Earlybird and Target Global as the two VCs, each making its first investment in the category; Earlybird's counsel Noerr (11 Sep 2019, https://www.noerr.com/en/press/noerr-advises-earlybird-on-investment-in-legal-tech-platform-lexfox): 'This is the first time Earlybird ... and Target Global have invested in a B2C Legal Tech start-up in Europe'; deutsche-startups DealMonitor 4 Sep 2019 the same. The NAME 'Series A' comes from EU-Startups (3 Sep 2019: 'has raised a seven-digit Series A round of financing led by Earlybird and Target'), read only as the Bing News and web-search snippet because the page sits behind a Cloudflare check, and from the tech.eu funding database row (Series A, 1 July 2019, Earlybird Venture Capital, Target Global), which loaded. Neither Gründerszene nor Noerr names the round.

rounds.round: unnamed in this source ('round of financing', seven-figure)

conny.status_detail: Conny GmbH (formerly Lexfox GmbH, Mietright GmbH; Berlin, HRB 182355 B) is active: annual report for 2024 filed January 2026, product in the press in August 2026. The register shows a capital reset to EUR 25,000 in December 2023 and a shareholder Speedright GmbH in 2025, which reads like a recapitalisation; no sale or insolvency found.

valuation.basis: No priced round states a figure; only one disclosed round (seven-digit).

conny.notes: Consumer-rights enforcement platform (wenigermiete.de: rent-cap claims, later labour and telecom claims), renamed from LexFox to Conny in 2020. Earlybird (Fabian Heilemann) and Target Global entered in the 2019 round; the round's name rests on a snippet and a database row, not on a page with full text. No later round found (Bing and Google News: "Conny" Legal Tech Finanzierungsrunde, "LexFox" Earlybird).

xayn-ag.name: Xayn (formerly XAIN, now Noxtua)

entry.quote: Xain has raised around €6m in a seed funding round led by Earlybird with participation from investors in Asia.
entry.entry_asserted: Silicon Republic (6 Jun 2018) and Gründerszene name the seed and Earlybird as lead investor; Christian Nagel 'joins the company's supervisory board'; the company was founded in February 2017 and this is its first institutional round; firm page: Invested 2018.

graduation.quote: Xayn has now raised almost $12 million in Series A funding led by the Japanese investors Global Brain and KDDI

xayn-ag.status_detail: Operating as Noxtua AG (renamed from Xayn AG in August 2025; Berlin, HRB 202784 B). The Series C of 23 September 2026 (more than EUR 100M) made the legal publisher C.H.BECK the majority shareholder while Global Brain, KDDI, CMS, Dentons and Dominik Schiener left the cap table. It is announced as a financing round, not a sale; Earlybird is not named among the leavers. The judge may read the change of control as acquired (C.H.BECK, 2026-09).

valuation.basis: Neither the Series B (EUR 80.7M, 2025) nor the Series C (more than EUR 100M, 2026) coverage states a valuation.

xayn-ag.notes: Oxford spin-off that moved from blockchain/federated learning (XAIN) to private search (Xayn) to sovereign legal AI (Noxtua). Earlybird led the EUR 6M seed in June 2018 and joined the 2021 Series A (graduated). Status is private with a strategic majority owner since September 2026: one call for the judge.

Firm page: Invested 2018. NO source names this round; the next one (Oct 2019, EUR 35M, Santander InnoVentures) is named Series B, so this was the round before the Series B, but the label is not in any record: round left null.

rounds.lead: Earlybird, ABN AMRO Digital Impact Fund

crosslend-gmbh-the-thing-gmbh.status_detail: The business collapsed in 2023: Finanz-Szene headline of 13 Sep 2023 'Crosslend: Eines der einst größten deutschen Fintechs ist implodiert' (paywalled, headline only); crosslend.com is now a registrar placeholder page; the subsidiaries CrossLend Investment Advisory GmbH and CrossLend Beteiligungs GmbH went into liquidation in Dec 2023 / Jan 2024 (the latter terminated Feb 2026). CAVEAT: the parent CrossLend GmbH (Berlin, HRB 160198 B) is still registered with one managing director, shows no insolvency or liquidation entry and filed its 2024 accounts in June 2026. crosslend-gmbh-the-thing-gmbh.notes: Digital debt marketplace: turns single loans into tradable notes (securitisation) for banks and institutional investors; the live page's 'Pre-Seed' label is wrong (it was a EUR 14M growth round into a 2014 company). Two soft points for the judge: the entry round has no name in the record, and 'defunct' rests on a paywalled headline plus a parked domain and liquidated subsidiaries while the parent GmbH still exists in the register (https://www.northdata.com/CrossLend%20GmbH,%20Berlin/Amtsgericht%20Charlottenburg%20(Berlin)%20HRB%20160198%20B). 'The Thing GmbH' in the firm's name for the row is not explained by any source I found.

lexoo-ltd.name: Lexoo

entry.entry_asserted: Legal IT Insider and Artificial Lawyer (4 Oct 2018): Earlybird leads the $4.4M Series A; the earlier rounds were Forward Partners' (2015 seed, TechCrunch $400K in Jan 2015). Firm page: Invested 2018.

lexoo-ltd.status_detail: Acquired by the alternative legal service provider Kalexius (Geneva), reported 22 March 2024; price not disclosed; the Lexoo brand and site continue (contract review).

valuation.basis: Acquisition price not disclosed; about $5M raised in total.

lexoo-ltd.notes: Online legal marketplace (matching companies with vetted lawyers in 70+ countries), later an outsourced contract-review service for in-house legal teams; category: marketplace, with SaaS as the alternative reading. The live list's 'Pre-Seed' label is wrong: Earlybird led the Series A in October 2018. A Zonebourse item (21 Mar 2024) words the deal as Kalexius buying Lexoo Limited from Earlybird and Forward Partners. Earlybird's own release ('London legal tech startup Lexoo secures 4.4M Series A led by Earlybird', 4 Oct 2018) sat at earlybird.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/181004_London-legal-tech-startup-Lexoo-secures-4.4M-Series-A-led-by-Earlybird-1.pdf, now 404; an archive capture would be the first-party citation.

No insolvency found in Bing/Google News ("Kreatize" Insolvenz) or the register.

freeverse.name: Freeverse

entry.entry_asserted: Tech.eu names only Adara Ventures and 4Founders Capital as 'existing investors'; the Spanish register records Christian G. Nagel (Earlybird) joining the board on 20 May 2022; the firm's archived page first lists the company in 2022 with 'Invested: 2022'. The live page's 'Invested 2020' conflicts with all three and is not supported by any round record.

freeverse.status_detail: Freeverse SL (Barcelona, NIF B67364729) was terminated in the Spanish commercial register on 22 January 2026 with a liquidator (Fernando Estalella); the chair, CEO and board left on the same entry. freeverse.io now redirects to laosnetwork.io: the LAOS Network, the chain Freeverse launched with the LAOS Foundation in December 2023, carries on outside the company. freeverse.notes: 'Living Assets': NFTs whose properties change with use, for games and brands (Barcelona, founded 2019). Earlybird co-led the Series A in May 2022; the entry YEAR is the open point (live page 2020, archive and every record 2022). The prefilled country US is wrong (a homonym, the old Mac game studio Freeverse). An Iberian Lawyer headline of 8 Jun 2022, 'Cuatrecasas and Garrigues on the sale of Freeverse', refers to the law firms on this financing; the page is blocked (403), so that reading is from the date only.

Earlybird (Fabian Heilemann, later Paul Klemm on the board) co-led the Series A in July 2018. No later round found (Bing and Google News: "Allthings" Finanzierungsrunde / funding / Series B; startupticker.ch list).

targomo.name: Targomo

entry.entry_asserted: The company's own release (Feb 2020) and Handelsblatt ('2018 sammelten die Gründer Geld beim Frühphaseninvestor Earlybird ein') date Earlybird's investment to 2018; firm page: Invested 2018. NO press, firm or company record names the round or its amount. A jobs-site profile (vendor grade) lists one round, 'Feb 2018 $4.9m SERIES A'; deutsche-startups puts total funding at about EUR 5M. valuation.basis: Sale price undisclosed, out of insolvency; about EUR 5M raised in total.

targomo.notes: Location intelligence software (travel-time and catchment analytics for retail, real estate, logistics), a 2013 Hasso Plattner Institute spin-off formerly called Motion Intelligence. Entry round is the gap: Earlybird invested in 2018 but the record gives no round name or amount (only a vendor 'Series A'). HQ: registered seat Potsdam (the firm's page says Potsdam), operating office Berlin (the company's 2020 release says 'Berlin-based'; the successor entity sits in Berlin). Register pages: https://www.northdata.com/Targomo%20GmbH,%20Potsdam/HRB%2026862
